sloka: पराङ्मुखवधं पापं यः करोत्यसुरेतरः ।स हन्ता न गतः स्वर्गं लभते पुण्यकर्मणाम् ।। ७.८.४ ॥
transliteration: parāṅmukhavadhaṁ pāpaṁ yaḥ karotyasuretaraḥ ।sa hantā na gataḥ svargaṁ labhate puṇyakarmaṇām ।। 7.8.4 ॥

translations.english: Whoever, not being a demon, commits the sin of killing those who have turned their back, that killer does not attain the heaven of those who perform meritorious deeds.
